title: Set the real round target, minimum and lead cheque on the Round page
notes: Every allocation number in the dashboards reads from this. The seeded values are placeholders.

title: Run a first conflict pass: check all 16 seeded firms against the competitor watchlist
notes: Open Conflicts and work the unchecked matrix. Nothing should reach outreach before it is cleared.

title: Identify the owning partner at each priority firm and record them under Contacts
notes: Contacts ship empty on purpose. A firm with no named partner has no process.

title: Fill current fund vintage and close date for the top ten firms from EDGAR
notes: Fund capacity scoring stays neutral until this is filled in.

title: Map at least one warm introduction path per priority firm
notes: No paths are seeded - inventing them would be worse than leaving it blank.

title: Write the platform risk memo before the first partner meeting
notes: This objection will come up in every process. Answer it in writing first.

title: Fill the six restricted data room items: model, cap table, prior docs, incorporation, IP assignment, customer contracts
notes: IP assignment gaps are the most common reason diligence stalls.

title: Decide whether to apply to YC Winter 2027 before the 2 November deadline
notes: See Programmes. Applying costs a weekend; not applying costs a batch cycle.

title: Decide on PearX W27 before the 4 October regular deadline
notes: There is an earlier deadline ahead of the regular one - check the site.
